description: L-shaped corner shim that takes up play between a square exercise-bike post (about 30 mm) and its socket. It wraps one corner and shims two faces at once; the flange hooks over the socket rim.
printing_notes: Print as exported, standing on the flange, no supports, with a brim if adhesion is marginal.
Use PETG or another tough filament, at least 2 perimeters' worth of line width. Check the printed wall with calipers, because upright walls come out slightly thicker than modelled.
To pick shim_t, measure socket and post on the same axis and take half the difference.
Fit it on the corner diagonally opposite the pop-pin, with the flange on top of the collar rim.
If it's too tight, drop shim_t by 0.1 in the customizer.
